milestone.title: mp autopilot restart + reconciliation after orchestrator or pane failure

intent.outcome: Interrupted autopilot sessions resume from durable events without duplicate dispatch, fabricated completion, or loss of evidence.

problem.description: Durable session writes are insufficient unless the orchestrator can reconcile them with live herdr panes and canonical milestone/review state after SIGINT, process death, pane loss, or partial command completion.

in_scope: Resume from last valid event sequence and schema revision.
Reconcile herdr workspace/panes, session roles, milestone criteria, reviews, and lifecycle state.
No duplicate dispatch; explicit outcomes for missing pane, corrupt tail, incompatible binary, and terminal session.
out_of_scope: UI replay rendering and full multi-milestone certification.

acceptance_criteria.description: Resume after orchestrator SIGINT continues from the last durable event without duplicate assignment or lifecycle command.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_resume -E 'test(/m225_ac01/)' --no-fail-fast exit 0 (1/1 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Missing/dead panes are classified by role and topology; safe respawn uses the stored prompt and actor rotation, while unsafe ambiguity escalates AwaitingUser.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_resume -E 'test(/m225_ac02/)' --no-fail-fast exit 0 (1/1 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: A corrupt or partial event tail recovers the last valid sequence without truncating prior events; incompatible schema/binary fails before mutation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_resume -E 'test(/m225_ac03/)' --no-fail-fast exit 0 (1/1 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Reconciliation cross-checks canonical criterion/review/lifecycle state and never restores stale session projections over newer plan evidence.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_resume -E 'test(/m225_ac04/)' --no-fail-fast exit 0 (1/1 pass)

design_decisions.choice: Canonical milestone criteria, reviews, and lifecycle revisions override stale session projections; append-only events and idempotency keys determine whether an effect may be replayed.
design_decisions.rationale: Recovery must not replace newer plan evidence or duplicate irreversible dispatch and closure commands.

work_packages.name: Restart reconciliation
work_packages.goal: Recover durable sessions against live panes and canonical plan state without duplicate effects.
work_packages.rollback: Leave interrupted sessions AwaitingUser and preserve all durable evidence.

steps.action: Implement resume from event cursor with idempotency keys for dispatch and lifecycle operations.
Reconcile stored role/pane identity with herdr liveness and implement safe respawn versus AwaitingUser classification.
steps.done_when: AC-02 covers each topology and pane-loss role.

steps.action: Recover last valid event sequence and reject incompatible schema/binary before writes.
steps.done_when: AC-03 preserves prior events and makes no mutation on incompatibility.

steps.action: Cross-check canonical criterion, review, and lifecycle revisions during recovery; never restore stale projections.
steps.done_when: AC-04 proves canonical newer evidence wins.

findings.description: M225 primitives (was_already_applied, classify_pane_loss, recover_event_tail, cross_check_canonical) are exported at crates/mp/src/autopilot/mod.rs:115-121 but NEVER called by any production code path. The spec's 'no duplicate dispatch', 'no fabricated completion', and 'resume from last valid event sequence' are unimplemented at runtime — they exist only as pure functions tested in isolation. The autopilot runtime path is cmd_autopilot_start (crates/mp/src/commands/autopilot.rs:162-179) which delegates to cmd_watch (crates/mp/src/commands/watch.rs:296-367), which uses crate::watch::reconcile (M152) — not M225. Existing recovery::recover_session (M207) is also only called by tests, not by any production code. The spec's in_scope items 'Resume from last valid event sequence', 'Reconcile herdr workspace/panes, session roles, milestone criteria, reviews, and lifecycle state', and 'No duplicate dispatch' are not enforced.
findings.author: reviewer

findings.description: The 4 M225 integration tests (m225_ac01..04 at crates/mp/tests/watch_resume.rs:347-580) are unit-style assertions over pure functions. They construct in-memory OrchestrationEvents and call pure functions directly. They never invoke a subprocess, never use FakeHerdrBuilder (M227), never simulate SIGINT/SIGKILL, never test that mp watch --resume or mp autopilot start actually deduplicates or validates against canonical state. The spec describes runtime restart behavior; the tests verify type definitions only. The orchestrator's review prompt explicitly requires 'the harness's death scripting must be USED, not just available' — confirmed false: zero grep matches for FakeHerdrBuilder or common::fake_herdr in watch_resume.rs. M227 reuse requirement (crates/mp/tests/common/fake_herdr.rs:62-77: 'Any new autopilot test that needs to inject a fake herdr binary MUST use FakeHerdrBuilder') is bypassed because the tests don't inject anything.
findings.author: reviewer

findings.description: compare_revisions uses lexicographic ordering of source_revision strings as a proxy for 'newer' (crates/mp/src/autopilot/reconcile.rs:837-858). The function comment claims 'hash strings the projection module uses are stable and ordered by the canonical's last_updated timestamp + content hash, so lexicographic comparison is a reliable proxy for newer' — but canonical_revision (crates/mp/src/autopilot/ac_projection.rs:161-176) produces only a 16-hex-char content hash via DefaultHasher with no chronological component. Two revisions of different content have unpredictable lexicographic order, so the cross-check can misclassify a dimension half the time, allowing stale session restoration over newer canonical state — the exact M200 failure mode the spec is preventing. Latent because F-01 means the function is dead code today, but the test m225_ac04_canonical_newer_revision_never_restored_over_plan_evidence (crates/mp/tests/watch_resume.rs:528-580) sidesteps the bug by manually setting p.source_revision='a-older-rev' rather than using real hash strings. Real source_revisions will not produce lexicographic-ordered test outcomes.
findings.author: reviewer
